text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap was taking part in special volunteer training
held in the mountains by the academy.
During a break...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Is this spot okay?

Yes! Once you count to ten there,
the game of tag begins!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"When you make eye contact with an upperclassman in the forest, challenge them to a duel"!
Thank you for accepting my challenge!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
As someone who possesses the spirit of a miler,
I definitely won't let you catch me, Oguri-senpai!

Graaan!
Hurry, run! Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I found a reaaally long path over here!
Ahaha, I can run as much as I want on this--!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "Playing tag out in nature... There are no bears around today, so we should be able to run freely."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin, Oguri-senpai!
Please come at me with all your might! Otherwise...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: There's no way they'll catch us!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hopping all over the place...
All the underclassmen have amazing physical ability.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Looks like I'll enjoy this!
—Ten seconds are up. Here I go...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmph, haaaaaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...! That's Oguri-senpai for you!
I'm giving it a full 200 miles too! Here I go-!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha! Got caught right away!
Hey, hey, can we go again?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"That was a truly... spirited run.
Do you have any secret to share?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The secret to my... running?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes. Just like you, Oguri-senpai, I also came to Tokyo from the regions. I wanted to ask about your mindset for continuing to fight on the front lines for your hometown's sake.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me.
I don't understand complicated things. But..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Today's contest was really fun, wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Your skills far exceeded my expectations.
It was truly thrilling."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Oguri-senpai looked like she was having fun!
It was super intense, but she didn't seem desperate!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to you. Strong opponents always make my heart tremble.
It makes me want to run more... and more."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, in other words... Having fun
is the secret to running?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That might be true.
Still, with just words, it's just so... ah.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Right, we'll be participating in a race event soon.
I want you to learn from it."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll show them what running with everything I've got looks like.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright... the outfit is good to go.
What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the racing event.
Oguri Cap's outfit shone dazzlingly under the room's lighting.
choice_data_list: It looks really good on you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Good.
The juniors came to watch today, after all.
choice_data_list: We competed together the other day, didn't we?
We competed together the other day, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, they were amazing girls.
Both their potential and their abilities were extraordinary."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They'll probably keep running too.
Just like me right now, through the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I have to keep moving forward too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Stronger and stronger Umamusume will appear from here on.
Heh... I look forward to running alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mun...!
Alright. It's about to start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap will keep on running.
Such a simple, obvious truth...
yet it brought a strange sense of joy.
choice_data_list: You really look like you're having fun again today.
You really look like you're having fun again today, huh?
Let's lead by example as their upperclassman.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap will keep on running.
Such a simple, obvious truth...
yet it brought a strange sense of joy.
choice_data_list: You really look like you're having fun again today.
You really look like you're having fun again today, huh?
Let's lead by example as their upperclassman.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Nothing gets past you, huh.
Well then... I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Watch over me today as well.
From your usual spot, just like always.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "If you're there cheering me on... it's so much more fun."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Doesn't that go for you as well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought.
You always look so happy watching my races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In that case... let's enjoy it even more.
In the upcoming races, together with me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I want them to learn as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What it truly means to win.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: For the next generation... I will show the way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because I promised.
That I'd show them my true, all-out running.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Watch me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Today, too—the one who wins will be me.
